description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data across three levels – Level 8.2, Level 12.1, and Level 7.0. The chart contains three slices, each representing one of these levels. The largest slice, colored in a light blue shade, is labeled “Level2 - 12.1” and occupies approximately 44.32% of the chart. A second slice, colored in a darker blue shade, is labeled “Level3 - 7.0” and represents approximately 25.64% of the total. The remaining slice, also light blue, is labeled “Level - 8.2” and accounts for roughly 30.04% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and there is no visible legend. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, from largest to smallest proportion.
